entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. This thing is a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I'm on the right track, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It doesn't matter what the issue is! I don't like it, and I want a refund. I've had it for over a month and I expect you're going to tell me it's **too late** because of some ridiculous **hygiene** excuse. This is outrageous!
I understand your frustration, and I want to help resolve this. I just need to pull up your order information first. Could you please provide the email address you used for the purchase?
It's angry_customer@email.com. Look, just get me your manager. I'm not going to listen to you read some script about a **sanitation** **policy** that prevents you from doing your job.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th, which was 37 days ago. I know you were concerned about the timing, but I actually have good news for you.
What good news? That you're going to offer me a 10% coupon after you deny my refund?
Not at all. For this particular product, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you right now. There's no issue with the timeframe.
Wait... what? Ninety days? Are you sure? I was expecting a huge fight.

Yes, I'm sure. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email address on file right now. All you need to do is package the sensor, attach the label, and drop it in the mail. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Oh. Wow. Okay, well... that's much better than I expected. Thank you, David. I appreciate you just handling it.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
